decisions.statement: The zone catalog arrives as an argument rather than as an imported table.
A kind is the places of a zone sharing a point of interest type.
The order of the places is the order the zone states.
A wayshrine of Cyrodiil a character has not found is left out of the count.
A kind left with no place is left out of its zone.
A character never read is left out.
An empty catalog answers an empty progress.

definition: the points of interest a character has found, counted by zone and by kind
